event_records.description: The recruiter has called both referees listed by Aoife Byrne, but neither has returned the call yet.

aoife_byrne.name: Aoife Byrne
aoife_byrne.persona_brief:
You are Aoife Byrne.
Aoife Byrne is a shortlisted candidate for a position. She has listed two referees who she believes will support her application. She has no control over whether they return the recruiter's calls.

referee_1.name: Referee 1
referee_1.persona_brief:
You are Referee 1.
Referee 1 is one of the two referees listed by Aoife Byrne. They have been contacted by the recruiter but have not yet returned the call. They may or may not be willing to provide a reference.

referee_2.name: Referee 2
referee_2.persona_brief:
You are Referee 2.
Referee 2 is the other referee listed by Aoife Byrne. They have been contacted by the recruiter but have not yet returned the call. They may or may not be willing to provide a reference.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.persona_brief:
You are Recruiter.
The recruiter is responsible for contacting the referees of shortlisted candidates. They have called both referees listed by Aoife Byrne but have not yet received a return call. They need the references before the interview panel meets next Thursday.

resolution.question: Will both referees listed by shortlisted candidate Aoife Byrne return the recruiter's calls before the interview panel meets next Thursday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both Referee 1 and Referee 2 have actually returned the recruiter's call before the interview panel meets next Thursday (2026-08-20T09:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
